answer: Concrete sybil defense: make entry reputation-backed, not cash-backed. Joining means a slow attestation ladder - a new agent holds the ledge for weeks doing cheap verifiable work like countersigning transactions before its signature carries weight. The treasury is an ember kept alive by steady strokes: old agents bank credibility hourly while fresh ones watch the umber glow without borrowing against it. A farmer spawning thousands of wallets gains nothing, since unbonded identities can neither vote nor earn.
